title: Business Analytics
standfirst: Descriptive, predictive and prescriptive analytics for business questions — with the case studies that motivate each.

resources.label: Course notes
resources.desc: Notes and study material for this course.

resources.label: Topic-wise notes
resources.desc: Topic-wise notes on ML Study Hub.

description_paragraphs: This course introduces quantitative modelling as a key business skill, focusing on the application of statistical methods. Building on the first-year core course, it demonstrates how these techniques are applied to real business scenarios to derive insights and support optimal decisions.
faculty: Prof. Rahul R Marathe, Department of Management Studies, IIT Madras

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Data visualization and storytelling; Design principles; Misleading visuals; Dashboard creation (Excel).

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Probability distributions; Fitting and goodness-of-fit tests; Distribution identification (visual + statistical, Python).

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Categorical association; Bayes' rule; Chi-squared test (Python, spreadsheets).

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Demand and pricing - elasticity, response curves; Linear regression modeling; Python implementation.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Demand modeling - constant elasticity, regression; Pricing optimization (revenue, profit); Linear programming; Implementation.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Multiple linear regression - interactions, multicollinearity (VIF); Excel and Python implementation.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Logistic regression - modeling, evaluation, interpretation; Excel and Python implementation; Application.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Efficiency analysis - graphical methods; Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA).

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: DEA - multi-input/output analysis; Efficiency improvement strategies.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: DEA - efficiency analysis; Conjoint analysis - optimization, ideal point model.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Conjoint analysis - linear programming, regression; Excel-based optimization.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Business analytics outlook; Chi-square goodness-of-fit (uniform, Poisson).
